decisions.conclusion: Current model transfers poorly; training-set fit does not establish operator generalization.

decisions.evidence: Feature names/order, normalization, CSV coordinate alignment, load/material values and frozen scaler agree. asinh amplifies one unseen-geometry tail, but large transfer error remains outside the single extreme node.
decisions.conclusion: No basis to clip labels/predictions or claim the error is merely an input schema or single-node problem.
decisions.next: Report raw physical metrics and encoded loss separately; investigate instability only if the new experiments show it.

future_hypotheses_not_launched: If global shape reduces train but not validation error, treat descriptor memorization as a hypothesis and study geometry representation/spatial conditioning rather than declare generalization.
If both variants remain poorly fitted, consider matched decoder capacity and case-identity diagnostic before adding complexity.
If geometry gain persists in validation, repeat a second seed or budget-matched refinement before locking final CAD/load evaluation.
After a viable stress model, jointly model raw uXYZ and stress; use FEM-consistent linear-load structure for displacement only, never linearly reconstruct signed scalar stress without evidence.
